independence.shared_history: Full parent history including prior PHYS25 results and two anchored PHYS26 candidate laws; no independent blindness claim.

arithmetic.source_literals: Decimal.from_float(float(source literal)), exact-real interpretation of frozen binary64 constants
arithmetic.J: exact stored decimal strings, no uncertainty enclosure

kernel.primary: Explicitly adapt PHYS25 original-fit log Taylor jet to degree 3; k=F(D^2 f+3D f), kprime=F(D^3 f+3D^2 f)/E; no ksecond or kthird evaluation.
kernel.separate_expression: Direct scalar sigma and analytic D log sigma, D^2 log sigma, D^3 log sigma; product rule gives k and kprime without the jet.

variance_cases.label: inherited_Vstar
variance_cases.source: PHYS25 primary_candidate.variance_eV2 exact stored decimal; approximate root boundary

variance_cases.label: inherited_W0
variance_cases.source: PHYS25 opposite_endpoint_law.variance_eV2 exact stored decimal; approximate root boundary

quadratics.expectation: c0+c1(m-c)+c2[W+(m-c)^2] for Q centered at c

checks: Every Pa/Pb law: nonnegative support, mass, mean, variance, raw second moment, photon number and photon energy.
Qa/Qb value contacts and tangent at the double contact.
Expectation of each quadratic computed from moments versus explicit Pa and Pb sums; contact attainment.
Pointwise Qa-k and k-Qb only at a,m,b in each W case; these samples have no global-proof credit.
Strict lower<upper in the five interior W cases; equality for both degenerate W endpoints.
Original scalar log-derivative path versus degree-3 jet for sigma,k,kprime at exactly five comparison centers.
Inherited stored roots and variances are reused; only local finite residual consistency is checked. No new bracket or search.
At W=19.74: alpha=.25 mixture and alpha=-Alower/(Aupper-Alower) numerical zero mixture; verify fixed moments and affine response.

tolerances.root_boundary_rule: finite residual must be reported, must not be called exact zero or certified interval

evaluation_budget.precomputation: one cached jet evaluation per unique law/comparison energy; no other energy generation

execution_policy.freeze: Code, protocol and all input hashes in PREEXECUTION_FROZEN.json before execution.
execution_policy.output: --output must be fresh; never overwrite evidence.
execution_policy.failure: Preserve original failure, stdout, stderr, exit and counts; no post hoc tolerance relaxation.
execution_policy.portability: One replay of this new program may be performed by parent; it is implementation portability only.

claim_ceiling: Numerically checked / implementation-verified. Continuum envelope and all-W sign claims require the separate mathematical proof. No native equivalence, source admission, J uncertainty, finite-time or finite-epsilon accuracy.
